scope: Original Gen 1–3 forms; visual simplification for Flock Around, not literal Pokédex height scaling.

Pidgey.design_notes: Small, plump bird; cream face and belly, three short crest tufts, angular black cheek markings, stubby pink bill, short brown tail.

Pidgeotto.design_notes: Raptor proportions, pink-red swept crest, cream underside and flight feathers, black cheek mask, alternating red and yellow tail feathers.

Spearow.design_notes: Rough, bristly brown head, narrow eyes, black back, pink-red wings with pale tips, striped beige underside and short hooked pink bill.

Fearow.design_notes: Small head, long pink spear bill, slender vulture-like neck, red comb, cream shaggy neck-base collar and broad cream-tipped wings.

Psyduck.design_notes: Round yellow biped, blank wide eyes with tiny pupils, exactly three black hairs, oversized flat cream bill, stubby tail and webbed feet.

Golduck.design_notes: Lean blue swimmer with a long rudder tail, four head horns, red forehead jewel and eyes, cream bill and clawed webbed hands and feet.

Farfetch'd.design_notes: Light brown duck, white belly, three-feather crest, black V brow, flat yellow bill, large grasping wings and a clearly held green leek.

Doduo.design_notes: Two equally sized fluffy brown heads on long slender necks; shaggy round body, long running legs, tiny almost invisible wings and sharp bills.

Dodrio.design_notes: Three equally sized heads, black V crests, slender necks, shaggy brown upper body, black lower body, long legs and three pale-red tail feathers.

Articuno.design_notes: Sky-blue graceful bird, three dark-blue diamond crest feathers, red eyes, gray bill and legs, white downy chest and a very long ribbon tail.

Zapdos.design_notes: Angular yellow lightning silhouette, spiky head, jagged yellow-and-black wings and tail, triangular masked eyes and a long orange spear bill.

Moltres.design_notes: Light-yellow body with a thin neck and pointed brown bill; flowing red-orange flame crest, tail and wing edges rather than ordinary red feathers.

Hoothoot.design_notes: Almost spherical brown owl, enormous red eyes with black gear rims and clock-hand brows, cream belly, tiny wings, pink bill and one visible foot.

Noctowl.design_notes: Tall brown owl, large cream eyebrow horns, red eyes with black and cream rings, dark triangular breast pattern, broad wings and fan tail.

Natu.design_notes: Tiny green sphere with almond eyes, yellow bill, red single crest and feet, and short yellow-red wings carrying thick black stripes.

Xatu.design_notes: Tall green totem silhouette, almond eyes, hooked bill, two long red crest feathers, cloak-like white wings with black/red tips and patterned body.

Murkrow.design_notes: Dark crow with three-tuft witch-hat crest, crooked yellow bill, red eyes, jagged neck collar, broom tail and red band at tail base.

Delibird.design_notes: Red upright penguin-like body, white face and chest ruff, paired white three-point brows, black eye markings, yellow feet and large white sack-tail.

Skarmory.design_notes: Lean armored silver bird, elongated steel-blue neck/legs/tail, triangular head crest, yellow eye, toothed spear bill, articulated plates and red underwing blades.

Lugia.design_notes: Silver-white streamlined dragon-bird, long neck, swept-back head point, dark blue pointed eye marks, pale-blue underside, dorsal plates and five-digit hand-wings.

Ho-Oh.design_notes: Large red/gold phoenix, yellow feather crest and fan tail, green neck stripe and wing tips, white underside, red ringed eyes and dark talons.

Torchic.design_notes: Orange fluffy chick with a round body and head, orange-yellow flame crest, tiny downy yellow wings, short bill and thin pale-yellow legs.

Combusken.design_notes: Upright yellow/orange chicken, orange three-point crest, orange waist chevron, powerful feathered thighs, long clawed arms and gray scaly lower legs.

Blaziken.design_notes: Tall red martial rooster, small V-crested red face, flowing cream mane framing chest, blue eyes, gray clawed hands and shaggy yellow lower legs.

Taillow.design_notes: Compact navy swallow, pointed red forehead-to-breast patch, white belly, short yellow bill, dark feet and short two-pronged pointed tail.

Swellow.design_notes: Lean navy swallow, swept crest, separated red face and breast patches, white underside, red feet, tapered wings and two long red-tipped tail streamers.

Wingull.design_notes: Neckless white gull with a large head, slit eyes, orange black-tipped bill, extremely long narrow blue-banded wings and blue-tipped fan tail.

Pelipper.design_notes: Head and immense yellow pouch dominate the body; white rear body, blue cap and feet, broad three-blue-tipped wings and black slit eyes.

Swablu.design_notes: Round blue bird with almost no separate neck, two slender blue head plumes, tiny white bill and feet, large cotton-white wings and two tail points.

Altaria.design_notes: Long graceful blue neck, small head, white cheek patches and bill, two long blue streamers, large cloud-white wing/body masses and five blue tail feathers.

Butterfree.design_notes: Purple two-segment butterfly with black antennae, red compound eyes, blue snout and limbs, broad white wings with black veins. User-requested insect exception to original bird roster.

Ledyba.design_notes: Red ladybug with five black cover spots, yellow torso and jaw, large white eyes, black antennae and six black limbs with white glove-like ends. Transparent insect wings beneath the covers.
